persona.title: Audit the base you just built
persona.purpose: Reads the base you just built in a fixed format: what it covers, what it strains and which finding you can claim today with a citation, with no sufficiency verdict.
persona.when: you imported the step 1 report and you need to know what that base holds.
persona.example: My generative AI sales Notebook, with six sources just imported.
persona.evidence: eight-line summary, finding table with type, evidence, impact and action, coverage reviewed, gaps prioritized by how much they block the purpose, and a claimable list with a citation per line.
persona.prompt: Step 2: I need to audit this base, just built in my step 1, against my purpose [PURPOSE] for [AUDIENCE], using only selected sources; cite each finding. Review coverage, tensions, ambiguities, quality, freshness, bias and redundancy; with a single source, audit bias first; when sources disagree, type a tension, do not average. Deliver an eight-line summary; a Finding|Type|Evidence|Impact|Action table; gaps prioritized by how much they block [PURPOSE]; and "what I can claim today", a citation per line or out. Do not write assistant instruction or starter prompts, nor call the base sufficient: that closes the workshop. Do not invent findings or citations.
